headline: Anthropic says Claude was running on AMD GPUs after about three days of work
body: Anthropic says in an investor presentation that Claude was running on AMD after just three days, with almost no human intervention. The Decoder says the figures haven't been independently verified.
note: If the figures hold, switching between chip vendors gets cheaper for AI labs, which matters to banks and payment firms that buy model capacity.

evidence.text: According to Anthropic, Claude was running on AMD after just three days, with almost no human intervention.
Anthropic now claims in an investor presentation that it has solved this problem using AI itself.
The figures come from Anthropic's investor presentation and haven't been independently verified.
